entities.summary: Anthony Cirelli is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a centre for the Tampa Bay Lightning of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Lightning in the third round, 72nd overall, of the 2015 NHL entry draft. Cirelli won the Stanley Cup back-to-back with the Lightning in 2020 and 2021.
